overview.en:
Inspect running Next.js applications through Vercel’s official DevTools MCP connector for runtime errors, routes and logs.

Inspect a running Next.js application through its available development diagnostics. Keep the route and reproduction context explicit when investigating runtime behavior.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
通过 Vercel 官方 DevTools MCP 连接器检查运行中的 Next.js 应用，查询运行时错误、路由和日志。

通过可用开发诊断检查运行中的 Next.js 应用，调查运行时行为时明确路由与复现背景。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.en: Inspect the available runtime errors in this Next.js application.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 检查这个 Next.js 应用中的可用运行时错误。

starterPrompts.en: Review the routes and logs relevant to this page issue.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 查看与这个页面问题相关的路由和日志。

starterPrompts.en: Prepare a diagnosis of this runtime problem with supporting evidence.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 准备这个运行时问题的诊断说明，并附上依据。

descriptions.en: Use Next.js DevTools in Ghast. Inspect running Next.js applications through Vercel’s official DevTools MCP connector for runtime errors, routes and logs. 通过 Vercel 官方 DevTools MCP 连接器检查运行中的 Next.js 应用，查询运行时错误、路由和日志。
